notes.note: The assign-contacts primary action is disabled at every count until Story 1.8: the button renders 'Assign N contacts', a disabled attribute and the inline handoff note, and campaign-assign-select.spec.ts pins 'Assign 0 contacts'. The write layer must replace that state with the pre-check, skip/move and POST, and update that spec row.

The selected-count denominator in components/campaign/assign-contacts-select.tsx is the total of the first unfiltered contacts read, because AssignableContactPage carries no scope total. If a later API adds one, replace the captured scopeTotal; the hidden count is page-relative only, so a tick hidden by a facet counts as hidden.

components/campaign/assign-contacts-types.ts mirrors AssignableContactPage, AssignableCaller and AssignmentSplitEntry by hand because lib/dialer/assignments.ts is server-only. A field added to the service page object (for example a 1.8 pre-check column) will not reach the client until this file is updated.

notes.reason: Story 1.8's UI layer replaced the disabled stub with precheck -> skip/move -> write
